deviations.reason: senses loaded=true is NOT stale spark .env wiring. The shipped fleet compose template defaults MULTIMODAL_BASE_URL to http://vllm-multimodal:8000 while MINOR_BASE_URL and MUSE_BASE_URL both default to empty, and ${VAR:-default} ignores an explicit empty value too (verified with docker compose config) — so no .env edit can unwire it and the asymmetry reproduces on EVERY fleet deployment, not just this box. Proven live: commented the line out, recreated the gateway shape-override-safe, container env came back identical and senses loaded stayed true. t1's by-proxy display already fixes the operator-visible symptom regardless, because _loaded_cell checks feasible+proxied before loaded.
